# A dirty linked source creates from its invocation HEAD and remains dirty.
exec realgit -C $HOME/code/project branch source/current
exec realgit -C $HOME/code/project worktree add --quiet $WORK/source source/current
cp dirty $WORK/source/tracked.txt
exec realgit -C $WORK/source status --porcelain=v1
cp stdout before-status

cd $WORK/source
exec zwm co -b feature/new
cmpenv stdout $WORK/created
! stderr .

exec realgit -C $WORK/source status --porcelain=v1
cmp stdout $WORK/before-status
assert-log $ZWM_TEST_LOG $WORK/want-log

-- dirty --
initial
dirty
-- created --
worktree_path=$ZWM_TEST_NEW_PATH
display_identity=feature/new
tab_action=created
tab_title=project:feature/new
tab_worktree=$ZWM_TEST_NEW_PATH
-- want-log --
